build.description: Build the project and fix errors
build.template: Run dotnet build on TelegramBotServer/TelegramBotServer.csproj and fix all build errors following AGENTS.md code style guidelines.

review.description: Review C# code for style violations
review.template: Review the current changes for C# code style violations from AGENTS.md. Check: nullable annotations, naming conventions, structured logging (no interpolation), async/await patterns, and DI registration.
